dct_description_sm: On-farm nitrogen response dataset from 83 corn (Zea mays L.) sites in Quebec, Canada (2021-2023), across the administrative regions of Montérégie, Outaouais, Laurentides, Lanaudière, Centre-du-Québec, Estrie, and Capitale-Nationale. Five N rates (0, 50, 100, 150, and 200 kg N/ha) were applied at V5-V7 in addition to a starter N application at planting, in a randomized complete block design with three blocks per site (15 experimental units per site, 1,245 in total). The dataset contains three targets (grain yield, N harvest index, and agronomic N use efficiency), soil physical, chemical, and biochemical indicators, tillage intensity (STIR), and monthly corn heat units and rainfall from May to October. Site identities are anonymized. A data dictionary is provided.
dct_title_s: Data for: Deciphering corn yield and nitrogen efficiency: Integrating soil health, climate, and management through explainable machine learning
